# istio_wasm_plugin (Resource)

Manages an Istio WasmPlugin resource. WasmPlugins extend Istio proxy functionality via WebAssembly modules.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "istio_wasm_plugin" "custom_auth" {
  manifest = jsonencode({
    apiVersion = "extensions.istio.io/v1alpha1"
    kind       = "WasmPlugin"
    metadata = {
      name      = "custom-auth"
      namespace = "istio-system"
    }
    spec = {
      selector = {
        matchLabels = {
          istio = "ingressgateway"
        }
      }
      url   = "oci://ghcr.io/my-org/wasm-auth:v1.0.0"
      phase = "AUTHN"
      pluginConfig = {
        auth_endpoint = "https://auth.example.com/verify"
      }
    }
  })
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `manifest` (String) Full WasmPlugin manifest as a JSON string. Must include `apiVersion`, `kind`, `metadata.name`, and `metadata.namespace`. The `apiVersion` in the manifest determines which API version is used (e.g. `extensions.istio.io/v1alpha1` or an older version like `v1beta1`). Sensitive fields (tokens, keys, passwords, etc.) are redacted to "(redacted)" in state after read.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource identifier in the format `namespace/name` (or `name` for cluster-scoped resources).
